title: RNA Isolation of Pinctada fucata martensii
author: Xiong Xinwei
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.9qgh5tw

steps.title: Tissue Lysis
steps.instruction: Prepare the tissue sample with TRIzol™ Reagent.

substeps.instruction: Place 50-100 mg of tissue into a 2.0 mL tube.
Add 1 mL of TRIzol™ Reagent per 50–100 mg of tissue.

steps.title: Mechanical Homogenization
steps.instruction: Homogenize the tissue using a TissueLayer 2 device.

substeps.instruction: Add a steel ball to each tube.
Flacker for 3 min at a frequency of 26 (1/S).
Repeat this process one time.

steps.title: Nucleoprotein Dissociation
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample for 5 minutes to allow complete dissociation of the nucleoproteins complex.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the RNA-containing aqueous phase from the lysate.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate for 15 minutes at 12,000 × g at 4 ℃.
Transfer the aqueous phase (~500 ul) to a new 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract the RNA using pre-cooled chloroform.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 ul of pre-cooled (4 ℃) Chloroform.
Securely cap the tube and shake for 1 min to mix completely.
Incubate for 10 min at 4 ℃.
Add 0.5 mL of isopropanol per 0.5 mL of aqueous phase and mix gently.
Incubate for 10 min at 4 ℃.
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 12,000 × g at 4 ℃.

steps.title: Supernatant Removal
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant to isolate the RNA pellet.

substeps.instruction: Remove as much supernatant as possible.
If necessary, centrifuge for 1 minute at 12,000 × g at 4 ℃ to remove remaining supernatant.

steps.title: RNA Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet with ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of 75% ethanol per 1 mL of TRIzol™ Reagent used for lysis.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 12,000 × g at 4 ℃ and discard the supernatant.
Repeat the resuspension and centrifugation steps one more time.

steps.title: Pellet Drying
steps.instruction: Air-dry the RNA pellet for 5 min at 4 ℃.

steps.title: RNA Resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the RNA pellet in 20–50 ul of RNase-free water.

substeps.instruction: Measure RNA concentration using a SimpliNano instrument.
Detect RNA integrity using a 1% agarose gel.
